episodes.title: Can an Evil Genius Crash on Your Couch for a Few Days?
Guilt Tripping
episodes.summary: Sonic and Tails save a village from bandits - and then find it difficult to leave because the villagers guilt them into staying.

episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Eggman?
episodes.summary: Orbot and Cubot wake up with no memory of the previous day and discover that Dr. Eggman is missing. The two bots must set out to find him.

episodes.title: Cowbot
episodes.summary: Tails reprograms one of Dr. Eggman's robots, accidentally turning it into a killing machine targeting Eggman. Sonic must protect his enemy.

episodes.title: Circus of Plunders
episodes.summary: Tails reprograms one of Dr. Eggman's robots, accidentally turning it into a killing machine targeting Eggman. Sonic must protect his enemy.

episodes.title: Unlucky Knuckles
episodes.summary: Knuckles changes the luck balance.

episodes.title: The Meteor
episodes.summary: A meteor causes Sonic and Eggman to exchange bodies.

episodes.title: Aim Low
episodes.summary: When Dr. Eggman loses his confidence he enlists the aid of motivational speaker and life coach, Soar the Eagle. Full of confidence, Eggman fires Soar only to discover that he's no longer capable of making a decision on his own.

episodes.title: How to Succeed in Evil Without Really Trying
Don't Judge Me
episodes.summary: When a berry picking machine created by Tails goes nuts and defoliates an orchard, a group of evil scientists thinks Tails is one of them and inducts him into their evil organization. Tails, not realizing their evil purposes, joins the group.

episodes.title: Dr. Eggman's Tomato Sauce
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman markets his own brand of tomato sauce. Does he have ulterior motives or does he just want to share his recipe with the world?.

episodes.title: Sole Power
episodes.summary: Every time Sonic runs, his speed causes a deafening tone so he's forced to give up his speed until a solution can be found. The remedy comes from a very unusual place, Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Hedgehog Day
episodes.summary: Eggman requires Sonic & the team's help when he keeps living the same day over & over again.

episodes.title: Sleeping Giant
episodes.summary: While enjoying some free time, Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails accidentally awaken a huge rock giant that proceeds to run amok.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Buddy Buddy Temple
episodes.summary: When Sonic and Dr. Eggman get trapped in an ancient temple, they must put their differences aside and work as a team in order to escape.

episodes.title: Let's Play Musical Friends
episodes.summary: When a living computer virus takes over all of Dr. Eggman's technology, Orbot and Cubot must enter the cyber world in order to defeat it.

episodes.title: Late Fees
episodes.summary: Sonic realizes he has 7 minutes to return Amy's library book and ends up racing the clock, as he battles slow senior citizens, burger cravings, and an angry Eggman.

episodes.title: Into the Wilderness
episodes.summary: When Sticks insists on being the one to teach Amy survival skills, Sonic and Knuckles challenge them to a race through the jungle.

episodes.title: Eggman Unplugged
episodes.summary: After Sonic and the gang best Eggman by using his own technology against him, Eggman swears off technology for good. In turn, the Lightning Bolt Society seizes this opportunity to unleash their own attack on the village, and Sonic and friends must get Eggman to use technology again in order to gain back control of his evil lair.

episodes.title: Chez Amy
episodes.summary: Fed up with the yucky food at Meh Burger, Amy opens a restaurant of her own and soon finds herself in a war for customers.

episodes.title: Blue with Envy
episodes.summary: When a super cool new shrew arrives and impresses everyone, Sonic worries that his days as the town's biggest hero are numbered.

episodes.title: The Curse of the Cross Eyed Moose
episodes.summary: Sticks worries that she and her friends may be cursed after they cross paths with a cross-eyed moose.

episodes.title: Chili Dog Day Afternoon
episodes.summary: Knuckles gets more than he bargained for when he sets out to track down rare peppers that will help me win the Chili Dog Cook-off.

episodes.title: Closed Door Policy
episodes.summary: After discovering that Sticks is a bit of a pack rat, Amy insists that she have a yard sale to get rid of her junk.

episodes.title: Mayor Knuckles
episodes.summary: Knuckles is asked to be the village's mayor for the day.  Turns out, not everybody's got what it takes to be a public servant.

episodes.title: Eggman the Auteur
episodes.summary: When Dr. Eggman sets out to make a movie about his own rise to power, he and Sonic have more than a few creative differences on the set.

episodes.title: Just a Guy
episodes.summary: Sonic gets some much needed sensitivity training after referring to Mike the Ox as "Just a Guy" incapable of battling Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Two Good to Be True
episodes.summary: Chaos ensues when a Knuckles look-alike from another dimension appears and the gang begins searching for a way to send him back home.

episodes.title: Beyond the Valley of Cubots
episodes.summary: After they find discarded Cubot prototypes hiding out in the jungle, Cubot and Orbot turn to Sonic and Tails to protect them from Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Next Top Villain
episodes.summary: When Dave the intern shows off to his mom, he accidentally captures Dr. Eggman. Suddenly, there is a new villain mastermind in town.

episodes.title: New Year's Retribution
episodes.summary: Eggman attacks during New Year's Eve.

episodes.title: Battle of the Boy Bands
episodes.summary: The guys go undercover as a boy band to prove that Amy and Sticks are being brainwashed by a pop icon.

episodes.title: Tails' Crush
episodes.summary: Tails is experiencing a crush; Dr. Eggman has a difficult time picking up his package from the post office.

episodes.title: Bro Down Showdown
episodes.summary: Sonic and Knuckles enter a best friend game show to win a new couch for Amy, but the show pairs Sonic up with Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Late Night Wars
episodes.summary: Knuckles is tapped to replace Comedy Chimp, but the host has plans to win back his old show--and they involve a certain egg-shaped villain.

episodes.title: Fire in a Crowded Workshop
episodes.summary: After a fire destroys Tails' workshop, Sonic and the gang have very different recollections of what happened.

episodes.title: It Wasn't Me, It Was the One-Armed Hedgehog
episodes.summary: Things around the village are disappearing--including Dr. Eggman's particle accelerator, and all the evidence suggests that Sonic is the thief.

episodes.title: Robot Battle Royale
episodes.summary: Determined to prove that he can invent stuff just as well as Tails, Knuckles enters a Robot Battle Royale contest.

episodes.title: No Robots Allowed
episodes.summary: After Dr. Eggman installs solar panels without a permit, the homeowner's association threatens to evict him from his villain lair.

episodes.title: Fuzzy Puppy Buddies
episodes.summary: Sonic becomes suspicious when Amy forms a connection with Dr. Eggman over a shared interest in the tabletop battle game, "Fuzzy Puppies".

episodes.title: Designated Heroes
episodes.summary: Dr, Eggman's got something up his sleeve when he challenges the members of Team Sonic to fight him individually rather than together.

episodes.title: Role Models
episodes.summary: After Sonic and the gang are declared honorary role models by the mayor, they find that their new titles are getting in the way of their work.

episodes.title: Cabin Fever
episodes.summary: When a storm forces the gang to take shelter at Amy's, they discover she's written a not-so-flattering play based on her friends.

episodes.title: Counter Productive
episodes.summary: Inspired by a new self-help book, Knuckles tris to fix mistakes from his past.  Unfortunately, things don't exactly go as planned.

episodes.title: It Takes a Village to Defeat a Hedgehog
episodes.summary: Realizing that he can't hope to topple Sonic by himself, Dr. Eggman calls on Shadow the Hedgehog to help him finish the fight.

episodes.title: Tommy Thunder: Method Actor
episodes.summary: Sonic allows action movie star Tommy Thunder to follow him for research, but the actor's ego overshadows Sonic's heroics.

episodes.title: Spacemageddonocalypse
episodes.summary: Team Sonic must find a way to stop a meteor from destroying the planet, while Dr. Eggman offers shelter to select villagers.

episodes.title: Nutwork
episodes.summary: When the media fails to cover the island's water shortage, Sticks starts a pirate radio show to expose the crisis, but receives unexpected attention.

episodes.title: Alone Again, Unnaturally
episodes.summary: Sonic tests an Ultrasonic Speed Amplifier device invented by Tails, but the zippy results push him into unfamiliar terrain.

episodes.title: The Biggest Fan
episodes.summary: After Sonic hires a devoted admirer as his personal assistant, his new work relationship is more fanatical than expected.

episodes.title: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Worse-er
episodes.summary: Overconfident in his skills, Sonic bets Tails that he can't capture him as Dr. Eggman eagerly awaits the result.

episodes.title: I Can Sea Sonic's Fear from Here
episodes.summary: Sonic must face his worst fears when Dr. Eggman attempts to lure him into an underwater battle.

episodes.title: In the Midnight Hour
episodes.summary: At the TV station, Sticks runs into a mysterious figure that plots to control the village, but no one believes her.

episodes.title: Multi-Tails
episodes.summary: Tails' plan to pretect the village backfires, prompting him to take an extreme measure to ensure he never duplicates failure again.

episodes.title: Strike!
episodes.summary: Tired of Dr. Eggman's treatment, Orbot and Cubot finally take action when they hit their breaking point.

episodes.title: The E--- Dr. Orbot
episodes.summary: The village decides to require permits to practice villainy, but Dr. Eggman must rely on Orbot when he can't pass the licensing test.

episodes.title: Knuck Knuck! Who's Here?
episodes.summary: Recovering from amnesia, Knuckles learns a fact about himself that inspires a journey to find a family to connect with.

episodes.title: Mech Suits Me
episodes.summary: When Sonic starts fooling around with an ancient battle suit he finds, his behavior suddenly becomes less than playful.

episodes.title: FiendBot
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman programs a new, giant robot to strategically know all of Sonic's moves, but the ensuing face-off doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Og Man Out
episodes.summary: An uncharacteristically peace-loving Froglodyte surfaces in the village but Team Sonic is cautious of his intentions.

episodes.title: Knine-to-Five Knuckles
episodes.summary: Knuckles wins a lamp and buys a house to store it in, but realizes he needs a way to pay off his newest purchase.

episodes.title: Blackout
episodes.summary: The village is left in darkness after its power source breaks down, forcing the gang to set off on a tough quest to find its replacement.

episodes.title: Unnamed Episode
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman senses an opportunity when the village holds an election to rename itself after learning it was named after a corrupt ancestor of Team Sonic.

episodes.title: Robot Employees
episodes.summary: With Meh Burger in need of improvement, Dr. Eggman creates a line of robots to work the counter, but the villain has an ulterior motive.

episodes.title: Give Bees a Chance
episodes.summary: Amy makes a questionable choice when she finds an injured Bee Bot left behind by Dr. Eggman after a fight.

episodes.title: Mombot
episodes.summary: In need of loving attention, Dr. Eggman invents a maternal robot that takeson other aspects of motherhood he didn't prepare for.

episodes.title: Muckfoot
episodes.summary: Tails sets out to prove that a mythical creature is real but gets caught in a dilemma when Sticks questions his findings.

episodes.title: Nominatus Rising
episodes.summary: Tails tests an invention that brings characters into the analog world and a digital villain becomes aware of the experiment.

episodes.title: Eggman's Brother
episodes.summary: Steve Eggman comes to town and claims to be Dr. Eggman's long-lost brother, but everyone except Sonic remains suspicious of his positive vibes.

episodes.title: Do Not Disturb
episodes.summary: After an endangered creature confines itself in his shack, Sonic must live with Tails, but learns that rooming with his best friend has its downside.

episodes.title: Robots from the Sky (1)
episodes.summary: Two robots from a city in the clouds crash in the village and misinterpret Team Sonic's actions during a tangle with Dr. Eggman's minions.

episodes.title: Robots from the Sky (2)
episodes.summary: Every robot in the villages turns bad, but Dr. Eggman doesn't appear to be the cause, leading Sonic and his pals to launch an investigation.

episodes.title: Robots from the Sky (3)
episodes.summary: As the village fends off a swarm of bad robots, Sonic and Tails visit the city in the clouds in search of a solution--but find a startling surprise.

episodes.title: Robots from the Sky (4)
episodes.summary: With everything on the line, Sonic and his pals work with the resistance fighters to increase their chances of victory against the army of bad robots.

episodes.title: Flea-ing from Trouble
episodes.summary: Tired of big losses, Dr. Eggman unleashes new tiny robots against Team Sonic that leaves them scratching their heads for a solution.

episodes.title: Lightning Bowler Society
episodes.summary: After a gripping match against the Lightning Bowler Society, Team Sonic prepares for a bowling rematch but their opponents might miss the showdown.

episodes.title: Planes, Trains and Dude-mobiles (1)
episodes.summary: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails take a road trip for their band's first gig and meet a shadowy drifter who could derail their debut performance.

episodes.title: Sticks and Amy's Excellent Staycation (2)
episodes.summary: While the guys are a way for their band gig, Sticks and Amy spend a relaxing weekend together, but get disrupted by a villain that isn't Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Inn Sanity
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman desperately needs money to pay off his trash bill but runs into a new set of problems after turning his lair into a luxury resort.

episodes.title: Mister Eggman
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman must go back to villain school when a secret about his education is revealed to the village.

episodes.title: The Haunted Lair
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman believes his lair is haunted by ghosts and sells it to the circus ringmaster, T.W. Barker, but Sonic wonders how spooky the estate really is.

episodes.title: Return of the Buddy Buddy Temple of Doom
episodes.summary: Team Sonic must stop Dr. Eggman from finding a supercharged crystal to power up his newest invention: a colossal battle suit.

episodes.title: Eggman's Anti Gravity Ray
episodes.summary: Annoyed with blowing winds, Dr. Eggman creates an anti-gravity ray, but his minion, Cubot, believes the invention can transform the village.

episodes.title: Victory
episodes.summary: To save their beloved rec center from being torn down, Team Sonic must compete in a final soccer match against Dr. Eggman's squad of robot rivals.

episodes.title: Three Men and My Baby!
episodes.summary: To make up for a joyride gone wrong, Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles agree to watch a baby and must contend with diapers, crying and Dr. Eggman.

episodes.title: Where Have All the Sonics Gone?
episodes.summary: Sonic searches for a way home when Steve Eggman and Dr. Eggman team up and send him to an alternate dimension where his friends don't know he exists.

episodes.title: If You Build It They Will Race
episodes.summary: Sonic and his pals design their own cars to race each other, but the mayor finds out and requires them to follow several rules.

episodes.title: Chain Letter
episodes.summary: Struggling to navigate social media, Dr. Eggman takes matters into his own hands and Sonic must deal with the fallout.

episodes.title: Vector Detector
episodes.summary: Amy needs help finding her trademark hammer, so she enlists the help of a TV investigator.  But he turns the search into a large production.

episodes.title: Three Minutes or Less
episodes.summary: As Meh Burger's new delivery boy, Sonic guarantees deliveries in less than three minutes, but Dr. Eggman plans to challenge his promise.

episodes.title: Lair on Lockdown
episodes.summary: Sonic and his friends visit Dr. Eggman to complain about his new online business, but end up stuck in his lair after an emergency lockdown.

episodes.title: You and I Bee-come One
episodes.summary: Tails tests a new device that accidentally unites him with an unwanted foe, pushing his friends to figure out how to reverse the process.

episodes.title: Don't Make Me Angry
episodes.summary: Seeking to boost his fighting abilities, Dr. Eggman conducts an experiment that unexpectedly changes him every time he gets too angry.

episodes.title: Eggman Family Vacation
episodes.summary: Unhappy at a resort with Steve Eggman and Mombot, Dr. Eggman tries to upgrade his vacation while disrupting Team Sonic's own relaxation time.

episodes.title: Return to Beyond the Valley of the Cubots
episodes.summary: Tails' lab assistant seeks a new purpose for its life when it meets other former Dr. Eggman employees, but the union shakes up the village.

episodes.title: Eggman: The Video Game (1)
episodes.summary: Dr. Eggman attempts to recruit a fierce foe to battle Team Sonic in his goal to create an epic video game that will boost his popularity.

episodes.title: Eggman: The Video Game (2): The End of the World
episodes.summary: When Dr. Eggman flees to another dimension after a revelation, Sonic must track him down before a cosmic imbalance destroys the world.
